public class Main {
    private static int countEvenRuns(String s) {
        return countEvenRuns(s, 0, '.', 1, 0);
    }

    private static int countEvenRuns(String s, int pos, char prev, int runLength, int count) {
        if (pos == s.length()) {
            return count + (runLength % 2 == 0 ? 1 : 0);
        }
        char current = s.charAt(pos);
        if (current == prev) {
            return countEvenRuns(s, pos + 1, prev, runLength + 1, count);
        }
        return countEvenRuns(s, pos + 1, current, 1, count + (runLength % 2 == 0 ? 1 : 0));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        System.out.println(countEvenRuns(in.next()));
    }
}

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {

        int result = 0;
        char previous = '.';
        boolean oddRunLength = true;

            char current = s.charAt(i);

                oddRunLength = !oddRunLength;
            } else {
                if (!oddRunLength) {
                    result++;
                }
                previous = current;
                oddRunLength = true;
            }
